population: Analytic approximation for the PGS000339 discovery population (100% European (PGS Catalog: GWAS, development and evaluation cohorts all EUR)), derived from the effect allele frequencies in the scoring file. Not an empirically scored cohort.
source: Law MH et al. Hum Mol Genet (2020). doi:10.1093/hmg/ddaa156

assumptions: Variants independent (approximately true for a clumped score)
